title: Digital IO Interface
text: Simulate digital input and output pins on processor, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, {Condition} sets Condition on when to trigger event Rising; {IO direction} sets the configure block as digital input or output, {Low input voltage}, {High input voltage}, {Enable event} sets the option to enable event generation and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: IO direction
params.values: Configure block as digital input or output Input (default) | Output

params.name: Low input voltage
params.values: Low input voltage threshold 0.2 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: High input voltage
params.values: High input voltage threshold 2.5 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Enable event
params.values: Option to enable event generation on (default) | off

params.name: Condition
params.values: Condition on when to trigger event Rising edge (default) | Falling edge | Both
